::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Kochi-based fabless IP venture aiming to become India's largest analog/RF/mixed-signal IP exporter by 2030. Also backed by MeitY's Chips-to-Startup (C2S) programme and a ₹7.59 crore DoT Telecom Technology Development Fund grant for LEO satellite-communication chips. Works with IIT Hyderabad, IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Guwahati, and CUSAT.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Analog, RF, and mixed-signal semiconductor IP; completed end-to-end design of a GaAs-based 5G low-noise amplifier/front-end module, and is developing LEO satellite-communication chips.
